verses.original: הִרְאַנִי֮ יְהוָה֒ וְהִנֵּ֗ה שְׁנֵי֙ דּוּדָאֵ֣י תְאֵנִ֔ים מוּעָדִ֕ים לִפְנֵ֖י הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֣י הַגְל֣וֹת נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֡ל אֶת־ יְכָנְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֩ וְאֶת־ שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה וְאֶת־ הֶחָרָ֤שׁ וְאֶת־ הַמַּסְגֵּר֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיְבִאֵ֖ם בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hir·’a·nî Yah·weh wə·hin·nêh šə·nê dū·ḏā·’ê ṯə·’ê·nîm mū·‘ā·ḏîm lip̄·nê hê·ḵal Yah·weh ’a·ḥă·rê haḡ·lō·wṯ nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ’eṯ- yə·ḵā·nə·yā·hū ḇen- yə·hō·w·yā·qîm me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- śā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- he·ḥā·rāš wə·’eṯ- ham·mas·gêr mî·rū·šā·lim way·ḇi·’êm bā·ḇel
verses.literal: After Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah as well as the officials of Judah and the craftsmen and metalsmiths from Jerusalem and had brought them to Babylon the LORD showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the temple of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Depois que Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, levou de Jerusalém cativos Jeconias, filho de Jeoaquim, rei de Judá, e os príncipes de Judá, juntamente com os artífices e ferreiros, e os trouxe para Babilônia, mostrou-me Jeová uma visão, e eis dois cestos de figos postos diante do templo de Jeová.

verses.original: הַדּ֣וּד אֶחָ֗ד תְּאֵנִים֙ טֹב֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד כִּתְאֵנֵ֖י הַבַּכֻּר֑וֹת וְהַדּ֣וּד אֶחָ֗ד תְּאֵנִים֙ רָע֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תֵֽאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵרֹֽעַ׃ס
verses.transliteration: had·dūḏ ’e·ḥāḏ tə·’ê·nîm ṭō·ḇō·wṯ mə·’ōḏ kiṯ·’ê·nê hab·bak·ku·rō·wṯ wə·had·dūḏ ’e·ḥāḏ tə·’ê·nîm rā·‘ō·wṯ mə·’ōḏ ’ă·šer lō- ṯê·’ā·ḵal·nāh mê·rō·a‘
verses.literal: One basket had very good figs like those that ripen early . . . but the other basket contained very poor figs so bad they could not be eaten
verses.literalPt: Um cesto tinha figos muito bons, quais são os figos temporãos; e o outro cesto tinha figos muito ruins, que não se podiam comer, de ruins que eram.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י מָֽה־ אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ וָאֹמַ֖ר תְּאֵנִ֑ים הַתְּאֵנִ֤ים הַטֹּבוֹת֙ טֹב֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד וְהָֽרָעוֹת֙ רָע֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵרֹֽעַ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay māh- ’at·tāh rō·’eh yir·mə·yā·hū wā·’ō·mar tə·’ê·nîm hat·tə·’ê·nîm haṭ·ṭō·ḇō·wṯ ṭō·ḇō·wṯ mə·’ōḏ wə·hā·rā·‘ō·wṯ rā·‘ō·wṯ mə·’ōḏ ’ă·šer lō- ṯê·’ā·ḵal·nāh mê·rō·a‘
verses.literal: Jeremiah the LORD asked what do you see Figs I replied The good figs are very good but the bad figs are very bad so bad they cannot be eaten
verses.literalPt: Então, me perguntou Jeová: Que vês tu, Jeremias? Respondi: Figos; os bons, figos muito bons; e os ruins, figos muito ruins, que não se podem comer, de ruins que são.

verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: A palavra de Jeová veio a mim, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּתְּאֵנִ֥ים הַטֹּב֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה כֵּֽן־ אַכִּ֞יר אֶת־ גָּל֣וּת יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁלַּ֜חְתִּי מִן־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה אֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים לְטוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl kat·tə·’ê·nîm haṭ·ṭō·ḇō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh kên- ’ak·kîr ’eṯ- gā·lūṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer šil·laḥ·tî min- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh ’e·reṣ kaś·dîm lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD the God of Israel says Like these good figs so I regard as good the exiles from Judah whom I have sent away from this place to the land of the Chaldeans
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová, Deus de Israel: Como tu atentas para estes bons figos, assim eu atentarei com favor para os exilados de Judá, que enviei deste lugar para a terra dos caldeus.

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י עֵינִ֤י עֲלֵיהֶם֙ לְטוֹבָ֔ה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֖ים עַל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את וּבְנִיתִים֙ וְלֹ֣א אֶהֱרֹ֔ס וּנְטַעְתִּ֖ים וְלֹ֥א אֶתּֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî ‘ê·nî ‘ă·lê·hem lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯîm ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ ū·ḇə·nî·ṯîm wə·lō ’e·hĕ·rōs ū·nə·ṭa‘·tîm wə·lō ’et·tō·wōš
verses.literal: I will keep My eyes on them for good and will return them to this land I will build them up and not tear them down I will plant them and not uproot them
verses.literalPt: Porei sobre eles favoravelmente os meus olhos e os farei voltar para esta terra; edificá-los-ei e não os demolirei; plantá-los-ei e não os arrancarei.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּי֩ לָהֶ֨ם לֵ֜ב לָדַ֣עַת אֹתִ֗י כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְהָיוּ־ לִ֣י לְעָ֔ם וְאָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים כִּֽי־ יָשֻׁ֥בוּ אֵלַ֖י בְּכָל־ לִבָּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem lêḇ lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ’ō·ṯî kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh wə·hā·yū- lî lə·‘ām wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’eh·yeh lā·hem lê·lō·hîm kî- yā·šu·ḇū ’ê·lay bə·ḵāl lib·bām
verses.literal: I will give them a heart to know Me that I am the LORD They will be My people and I will be their God for they will return to Me with all their heart
verses.literalPt: Dar-lhes-ei coração para que me conheçam, que eu sou Jeová; eles serão o meu povo, e eu serei o seu Deus. Pois se voltarão para mim de todo o seu coração.

verses.original: וְכַתְּאֵנִים֙ הָֽרָע֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵרֹ֑עַ כִּי־ כֹ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה כֵּ֣ן אֶ֠תֵּן אֶת־ צִדְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֤ה וְאֶת־ שָׂרָיו֙ וְאֵ֣ת׀ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הַנִּשְׁאָרִים֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וְהַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵat·tə·’ê·nîm hā·rā·‘ō·wṯ ’ă·šer lō- ṯê·’ā·ḵal·nāh mê·rō·a‘ kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh kên ’et·tên ’eṯ- ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- śā·rāw wə·’êṯ šə·’ê·rîṯ yə·rū·šā·lim han·niš·’ā·rîm bā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ wə·hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: But like the bad figs so bad . . . they cannot be eaten says the LORD so will I deal with Zedekiah king of Judah his officials and the remnant of Jerusalem those remaining in this land and those living in the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Como tu desprezas os figos ruins, que não se podem comer, de ruins que são, certamente, diz Jeová: Do mesmo modo, desprezarei eu a Zedequias, rei de Judá, os seus príncipes e o resto de Jerusalém, que ficam nesta terra, e os que moram na terra do Egito.

verses.original: וּנְתַתִּים֙ לִזְוָעָה לְרָעָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ לְחֶרְפָּ֤ה וּלְמָשָׁל֙ לִשְׁנִינָ֣ה וְלִקְלָלָ֔ה בְּכָל־ הַמְּקֹמ֖וֹת אֲשֶֽׁר־ אַדִּיחֵ֥ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṯat·tîm liz·wå̄·ʿå̄h lə·rā·‘āh lə·ḵōl mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ lə·ḥer·pāh ū·lə·mā·šāl liš·nî·nāh wə·liq·lā·lāh bə·ḵāl ham·mə·qō·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer- ’ad·dî·ḥêm šām
verses.literal: I will make them a horror and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth a disgrace and an object of scorn ridicule and cursing wherever . . . I have banished them . . .
verses.literalPt: Farei que sejam espetáculo horrendo, ofensa a todos os reinos da terra, opróbrio e provérbio, escárnio e maldição, em todos os lugares para onde os arrojarei.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֣חְתִּי בָ֔ם אֶת־ הַחֶ֖רֶב אֶת־ הָרָעָ֣ב וְאֶת־ הַדָּ֑בֶר עַד־ תֻּמָּם֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תִּי לָהֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·laḥ·tî ḇām ’eṯ- ha·ḥe·reḇ ’eṯ- hā·rā·‘āḇ wə·’eṯ- had·dā·ḇer ‘aḏ- tum·mām mê·‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem wə·la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: And I will send against them sword and famine and plague until they have perished from the land that I gave to them and their fathers
verses.literalPt: Enviarei entre eles a espada, a fome e a peste, até que sejam consumidos de sobre a terra que lhes dei a eles e a seus pais.
